name: Ricardo Albuquerque
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport IT began unexpectedly. He was working for a large telecommunications company when Target Racing, a client, experienced a catastrophic network failure during a crucial testing session. Ricardo, known for his calm demeanor under pressure, single-handedly restored their systems within hours, earning the team's immediate respect. He was promptly offered a position leading their IT systems, a role he embraced as a chance to blend his technical expertise with his lifelong passion for racing.

At Target Racing, Ricardo is the linchpin ensuring smooth data flow across all departments, from trackside telemetry to simulation rigs in the factory. He takes a proactive approach, always anticipating potential technological bottlenecks and implementing preventative measures. His colleagues appreciate his ability to explain complex IT concepts in simple terms, fostering a collaborative environment. 

Ricardo stands out not only for his technical prowess but also for his forward-thinking ideas. He constantly explores new technologies to enhance team performance, making him a valuable asset in the competitive world of motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a focused gaze and a confident posture.

quirks: Insists on using a mechanical keyboard, even at the track
Always carries a small notebook filled with coding snippets and racing strategy ideas
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought
